es_JKmdV5finxyMbRUc.note: Intended reading (and the accepted answer): every non-zero entry lies in the a × b submatrix formed by those a rows and b columns, so at most min{a, b} independent entries exist. If "covered" is read as a line cover (each non-zero entry lies in one of the a rows or one of the b columns), only ≤ a + b is guaranteed (König–Egerváry).
